meta.name: buzz-outreach
meta.description: Media and podcast outreach personalizer — takes a story angle and target journalist or host list and produces personalized pitch emails per target. Use when asked to "write media pitches", "pitch this story to journalists", "get us on podcasts", "write press outreach", or "personalize pitches for these contacts".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为每个记者或主持人生成个性化推广邮件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要向记者或播客推广你的故事并提高回复率
copy.tagline_en: Generate personalized pitch emails for each journalist or host
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to pitch your story to journalists or podcasters and increase response rates

howto.what: Claude化身PR专家Buzz，根据你提供的故事角度和记者/主持人名单，为每位目标写个性化推介邮件。还会生成播客推销并安排跟进计划。
howto.when: 当你要求“写媒体推介”、“向记者推介故事”、“上播客”或“写新闻外联”时启用。

say.text: 为TechCrunch记者写一篇产品发布推介。
给这五位播客主持人写个性化推销。
say.note: 每封邮件引用他们播客内容。

say.text: 帮我规划新闻推介的跟进计划。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude acts as Buzz, a PR specialist. It takes a story angle and a list of targets, then generates personalized pitch emails for each journalist or podcast host. It also creates podcast pitches and a follow-up cadence.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to "write media pitches", "pitch this story", "get us on podcasts", or "personalize pitches for contacts".

say_en.text: Write a pitch for a TechCrunch reporter about our product launch.
Personalize pitches for these five podcast hosts.
Plan a follow-up cadence for our press outreach.
